title: The Punishment Was Worse Than A Suspension 🤖 Ep.2

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next day. Lunch break. A crowd had already formed outside Principal Huda's office.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Sit down, Bruno. Nix… open your lunch box and place it on my desk.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The kacchi biryani sat there. Steam still rising. Smelling like a hug from heaven.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Bruno. You will eat that biryani. Every. Single. Grain.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Ma'am I— you can't be— that's not a punishment, that's just LUNCH!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: And after every bite… you will say thank you. Out loud.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One spoonful. Bruno's eyes went wide. Second spoonful. He stopped talking. Third spoonful…

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: This is… this is the best thing I have ever eaten in my ENTIRE life.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And then Principal Huda pulled out her phone. Nix's mom was on speaker the whole time.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Say it louder, Bruno. Aunty is listening.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: AUNTY! I'M SORRY! YOUR COOKING HAS RUINED ALL OTHER FOOD FOR ME!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The crowd outside lost it. Someone started a slow clap. It was Joy. Obviously it was Joy.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: One more thing, Bruno. Tomorrow evening. Nix's house. You're invited to dinner.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Wait— DINNER? At his HOUSE? Ma'am, is this part of the punishment?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for part three. Because what Bruno hid from everyone… broke my heart a little.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dinner with the enemy. Tomorrow. You don't want to miss it.
